mapper.insert: INSERT INTO access_clean_batch (batch_type, window_start, window_end, status) VALUES (#{batchType}, #{windowStart}, #{windowEnd}, #{status})
mapper.select: SELECT id, batch_type AS batchType, window_start AS windowStart, window_end AS windowEnd, status, raw_in AS rawIn, cleaned_out AS cleanedOut, visit_out AS visitOut, review_count AS reviewCount, error_message AS errorMessage, started_at AS startedAt, finished_at AS finishedAt FROM access_clean_batch WHERE id = #{id}

SELECT id, batch_type AS batchType, window_start AS windowStart, window_end AS windowEnd, status, raw_in AS rawIn, cleaned_out AS cleanedOut, visit_out AS visitOut, review_count AS reviewCount, error_message AS errorMessage, started_at AS startedAt, finished_at AS finishedAt FROM access_clean_batch ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT #{limit}
